reviews.t: Very nice oil.
reviews.x: Very nice oil.... trying to figure out how to get rid of granuals... absorbs quickly , not too greasy. Hoping for long term silky skin results.

reviews.t: 5 STAR BUTTER!! GREAT SMELL AND FEELS SMOOTH!!
reviews.x: Got this recently for the purpose of using on my heels of my feet. My heels get so dry and I needed a organic product to help.  I ABSOLUTLY love this mango butter!! Goes on smooth and does not leave a greasy finish.  It has done so well at moisturzing my heels I have used it other places like my hands and even my hair!!  I'll be purchasing this for all the ladies in my family at Christmas!! Its a wonderful stocking stuffer and will last a long time!! Great Value!!

reviews.t: Granular wax... don't fall for other bogus reviews
reviews.x: Terrible, granular wax in a jar...don't fall for previous reviews.

reviews.t: this was terrible. It was gritty
reviews.x: First time trying mango butter, so I'm going to give this the benefit of the doubt and not leave 1 star... That being said, this was terrible. It was gritty. Even after gently melting in a bowl of warm water, half the container was this weird clump of grit (think of bees wax, or even sea salt). Ruined a batch of body butter I was making; you can not whip away the grit. If this is normal of mango butter, then maybe it's just not for me. But I'm going to give another brand a try before I give up a

reviews.t: Gritty.
reviews.x: Something was wrong with this product.  It was gritty so I tried heating it in microwave - a small amount pooled on the top but I was not able to incorporate it into the rest - I fear it maybe froze somewhere on the way.  Amazon refunded my money.  Thank you.

reviews.t: More like mango salt - the product crumbles and does not ...
reviews.x: More like mango salt - the product crumbles and does not penetrate the skin. I've bought other products from Majestic Pure and found the quality poor. I will no longer purchase their products.

reviews.t: Awesome, smooth mango butter! May be gritty though, must melt down to fix
reviews.x: Very smooth and creamy mango butter. Quickly melts in your hand with body heat and quickly dissolves into skin. Luv that! Product did arrive very gritty with small, tiny hard grits. I quickly fixed that by resetting it by placing jar inside a bowl of boiling water, letting the water cool for about 2-3 minutes before putting in the jar. This quickly melted all the grits away into a beautiful, golden liquid. Then I placed jar into refrigerator to bring back to solid form, which was a creamy, smoot

reviews.t: Great for skin allergies and eczema!!
reviews.x: The mango butter looks exactly like the picture and works good for a skin and hair moisturizer I reccomend putting the mango butter in the microwave or on the stove so it can fully melt and then adding it to desired area. I have eczima and skin allergies and the only thing that seems to work on me is natural moisturizers like the cocoa butter Shea butter but all natural straight from Africa that's why I love amazon because I can order all of my stuff online

reviews.t: Bought this with aloe butter. Needed a change from ...
reviews.x: Bought this with aloe butter. Needed a change from shea butter as that smell is too much for me. This is ok. It's a bit gritty. I find myself having to rub it in my palms, only for a bit of grit to still be left but it does make my hair soft. You can probably add essential oil to it as it does have that weird nutty smell but it is faint. The grit is my only issue, other than that i would suggest this to friends.

reviews.t: I love the effects of the mango butter on my hair
reviews.x: I love the effects of the mango butter on my hair. It provides shine and softness. The grittiness of the mango butter drives me crazy. I read reviews on several products and it seems that maybe the consistency of mango butter is naturally gritty.  I used a double boiler method to heat it up and applied it to my hair which eliminated the grittiness.

reviews.t: Wonderful!
reviews.x: I have been uses shea butter for making lip balms but wanted something smoother and a bit more nourishing. Wow! I am in love with this Mango butter!!! It is a wonderful product, no offensive smell and super hydrating for lips! I am going to make some body Butter with it next, I can only imagine how great it will work for skin!

reviews.t: Don't waste your money!
reviews.x: Total waste of money! Saddened that I gave this as part of a gift basket! Crumbly, takes forever to melt so you can rub it in, oily and sticky - everything opposite of what the description says! Had really high hopes for a great product, but was even more disappointed.

reviews.t: Didn't realize it was being sold as butter rather than ...
reviews.x: Didn't realize it was being sold as butter rather than crude mango butter because that's what it is. Had little seedlings of mango butter in a jar. Not worth it.

reviews.t: Grainy like texture felt like sand on my skin.
reviews.x: very grainy like texture, attempted to use this after stepping out of the shower, this felt like sand and took a lot of friction before it melted. first mistake was attempting to use this in my hair. This resembled dandruff causing me to immediately wash out my hair. The smell wasn't as pleasant, I expected some type of tropical scent for "mango butter''. the seller had great customer service; reached out to be by email. Although I never responded. Wish I liked the product.

reviews.t: My whole bottle crystallized
reviews.x: I had high expectations of this butter .. it smells great and feels great however my whole bottle has crystallized and lots of it doesn't melt once I apply it to my skin so I have little white needs all over me when I'm trying to use it.. I believe this comes from not being heated and cooled properly. It's a natural phenomenon that happened in most butters but mostly mango and shea, so I can't be to upset. However it can be avoided if heated and cool properly .

reviews.t: because it doesn't coat on like normal hair grease
reviews.x: This wasn't creamy ,but it melts well in your fingers. I recently purchased a flat iron and used this as a heat protectant. Works very well. Although I may have used too much ,because it doesn't coat on like normal hair grease.

reviews.t: amazing lotion
reviews.x: This smells like heaven ....I Love this lotion...and it goes on thick and it totally moisturized my skin...there wasnt any oily after feeling and i will definitely be using this every night ...I love this lotion..

reviews.t: Love this product
reviews.x: Love this products, but it doesn't completely melt. It will leave little beads.

reviews.t: Mango butter
reviews.x: Not impressed. No mango smell and very grainy. Too much work to apply.

reviews.x: Too dry and crumbling Very disappointed for the price I paid

Even 10 min. later after trying to rub out these grains, you will still find what feels like sand everywhere, incld. you clothes and floor. reviews.x: I ordered the Majestic Pure Mango Butter, Raw & Organic, because I have been using the Cocoa and Shea butter from this same company and the Mango Butter can be used as a substitute in several of the recipes for my dry skin. I was pleasantly surprised as to the smell. I expected it to be fruity , but instead it was kind of nutty. In reading this is not extracted from the fruit, but the kernels. This does leave a light oily, greasy layer on your skin when applied directly and takes a while to

reviews.t: Great moisturizer once you learn to melt it first! :)
reviews.x: Once melted (usually I run hot water over the container but it takes a while) this is a wonderful oil. If you're not used to Mango Butter, it is very dry and somewhat gritty before melting it. Once it's melted, it has the consistency of coconut oil melted. I use it on my entire body. I also add a few drops of lemon, lavender and mint essential oils to give it a nice fresh scent. This tub lasts a long time. I'd recommend it anywhere you'd used moisturizers. claims.text: Many reviewers report the product arrives gritty or grainy, often requiring melting to fix.
Reviewers praise the product for making skin soft, smooth, and moisturized.
Several reviewers complain the product is crumbly, hard to melt, or does not absorb well.
Some reviewers note the product absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy finish.
A few reviewers mention the product works well for hair, providing shine and softness.
